text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
And now, it begins once again this year!
The dream Grand Prix race carrying the hopes of all the fans: the Takarazuka Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
"Now, let's take a look back at
the preliminary fan vote results. First, in 1st place is—"

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: "—And here was last year's Triple Tiara Umamusume, Still in Love. In 9th place! By the way, her current popularity ranking is—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the first place, there is a common perception in the Twinkle Series
that Umamusume on the Classic Triple Crown path
are stronger than those on the Tiara path.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, it is somewhat inevitable, but...
for only the second Triple Tiara Umamusume in history
to be sitting at this position is truly baffling.
choice_data_list: (It's as if... an unknown force is at work.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Although she won't be running this time, the fact that
her rival Admire Groove was voted 5th place
only fuels her frustration even further.
choice_data_list: ...Even though Still is still just as strong...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Please do not let it trouble you.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I'm okay.
Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Expectations are something... I have never been accustomed to in the first place. Besides—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Proof that there are many people far stronger than me...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: In that case... it should be quite satisfying, which suits me just fine.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
My heart beats faster. Standing right before me...
is certainly the same girl she always is.
And yet...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Something is wrong.
Something—something is... changing."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Well then...
let us head to the paddock.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Yes?
choice_data_list: Which one are you right now...?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe.
What a funny Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: —It's me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaaaaaah...!)

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Mhm-mhm, love it!
This Grand Prix atmosphere!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
It's packed to the brim with hopes and dreams!
Right?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"The future hero, Zenno Rob Roy!
You fought hard along the Classic Triple Crown route last year,
but you're planning on aiming even higher now, right?"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"...Wait, you look anxious!
You've got a face that says,
'If only my rival, Neo Universe, were here...'"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: R-Rivals, you say...? No way...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"...However, it is truly a shame.
If not for the injury... Uni would be here too."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I get it. I wanted to
go at it with her one more time too.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Listen up, Rob Roy! If they can't be here, we'll just have to have enough fun for all of us!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Let's live up to their hopes and dreams!
With a thrilling, exciting race—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Huh? Uh, umm... Tap...?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"……I take it back, Rob Roy.
Looks like the excitement will have to wait."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
It seems
you have been revived...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: ――A Monster...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Oooone.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Twooo.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Threeee... foouur... fiiive.
Siiix—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Seven.
...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"So much delicious food for today's feast...
Hehe. Hehehe..."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...Ngh...!
Ah, don't panic... It's going to be okay...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: —My prey won't get away!!
